name: Vitalij Syroezhkin
source:
We play as Vitaly Tsal.
Arthas, as usual, lives his gray everyday life, starting streams.
But a turning point occurs in his life...
And guess where he ends up?
Yes, yes, exactly there.
What adventures await him there?
